name: African elephant
general_info: The African elephant is the largest living terrestrial animal, normally reaching 6 to 7.3 meters in length and 3.5 to 4 meters in height at the shoulder, and weighing between 6,000 to 9,000 kg. The African elephant is a herbivorous animal. Its diet varies according to its habitat; elephants living in forests, partial deserts, and grasslands all eat different proportions of herbs and tree or shrubbery leaves. Elephants inhabiting the shores of Lake Kariba have been recorded eating underwater plant life. To break down the plants it consumes, the African elephant has four large molars, two in each mandible of the jaw. Each of these molars is 10 cm wide and 30 cm long. Over time, these molars are worn away and new ones are grown to replace them as the elephant ages.

name: Nile crocodile
general_info: The Nile crocodile is the largest freshwater predator in Africa, and may be considered the second-largest extant reptile and crocodilian in the world, after the saltwater crocodile. The Nile crocodile is quite widespread throughout sub-Saharan Africa, occurring mostly in the central, eastern, and southern regions of the continent and lives in different types of aquatic environments such as lakes, rivers, and marshlands. Although capable of living in saline environments, this species is rarely found in saltwater, but occasionally inhabits deltas and brackish lakes. The range of this species once stretched northward throughout the Nile, as far north as the Nile delta.

name: Lioness
general_info: The lioness is a social feline, living in prides where she plays a key role in hunting and raising cubs. Lionesses are slightly smaller than male lions and lack a mane. They hunt in groups, often targeting large herbivores like zebras and wildebeest. Their strong social bonds make them effective cooperative hunters.

name: Lion
general_info: Lions are one of the most recognizable big cats, known for their majestic manes and social structure. They live in prides and are apex predators, relying on cooperative hunting to catch prey such as zebras, buffalo, and antelope. Males protect the territory while females do most of the hunting.

name: Hippopotamus
general_info: The hippopotamus is a semi-aquatic mammal found in rivers and lakes. Despite their stocky appearance, they are highly aggressive and can run surprisingly fast on land. They spend most of the day in water to keep cool, emerging at night to graze on grasses.
habitat: Rivers, lakes, and other water bodies

name: Golden Eagle
general_info: Golden eagles are large birds of prey known for their keen eyesight and powerful hunting skills. They primarily feed on small to medium-sized mammals and birds, using their speed and sharp talons to catch prey. These eagles are found in open terrain, such as mountains and tundras.

name: Dolphin
general_info: Dolphins are highly intelligent marine mammals known for their playful behavior and complex social structures. They use echolocation to navigate and hunt, feeding primarily on fish and squid. Dolphins communicate using a variety of clicks and whistles.

name: Great white shark
general_info: The great white shark is a powerful apex predator, reaching up to 6 meters in length. It has a keen sense of smell and excellent eyesight, allowing it to detect prey from long distances. These sharks feed mainly on fish and marine mammals like seals.

name: Zebra
general_info: Zebras are striped herbivores native to the African savanna. Their distinctive black-and-white stripes serve as a form of camouflage and help deter predators. They are highly social animals and travel in herds to stay safe from lions and other predators.

name: Rhinoceros
general_info: Rhinoceroses are large, thick-skinned herbivores with a distinctive horn made of keratin. They are known for their strength and aggressive behavior when threatened. Due to poaching for their horns, rhinos are critically endangered.

name: Central European boar
general_info: The Central European boar is a highly adaptable wild pig species known for its intelligence and strong foraging abilities. It feeds on a variety of foods, including roots, nuts, small animals, and carrion. These boars have sharp tusks and can be aggressive when threatened.

name: European brown bear
general_info: The European brown bear is one of the largest land carnivores, though it has an omnivorous diet consisting of berries, fish, and small mammals. It is a solitary animal that hibernates in winter and plays a key role in maintaining ecological balance in its habitat.

name: Deer
general_info: Deers are herbivorous mammals found in forests, grasslands, and other habitats around the world. They are known for their agility, graceful movements, and antlers, which males grow and shed annually.

name: European grey wolf
general_info: The European grey wolf is a large carnivorous species found across Europe and parts of Asia, known for its powerful build and pack-oriented behavior. Wolves communicate with each other through a variety of vocalizations, including howls that can be heard up to 10 miles away in the right conditions!

name: Arctic wolf
general_info: The Arctic wolf is a subspecies of the grey wolf adapted to the harsh Arctic environment. These wolves have a thick white coat that provides camouflage in the snow and helps them survive in cold temperatures. Arctic wolves primarily feed on muskoxen and Arctic hares.

name: European hare
general_info: The European hare is a fast-running species native to Europe and parts of Asia, often seen in open fields and grasslands. European hares are known for their impressive speed and agility, capable of reaching up to 45 miles per hour when evading predators!

name: Carrion crow
general_info: The carrion crow is a highly intelligent bird found across Europe and parts of Asia, known for its all-black plumage and distinctive cawing call. Carrion crows are known to use tools, such as sticks, to extract food from hard-to-reach places, showcasing their remarkable problem-solving skills!

name: Golden Guernsey
general_info: The Golden Guernsey is a rare and distinctive breed of goat from the Channel Islands, known for its golden or cream-colored coat and docile nature. Golden Guernseys are excellent milk producers, and their rich, flavorful milk is often used to make delicious cheese!

name: Humboldt squid
general_info: The Humboldt squid, also known as the jumbo squid, is a large, aggressive cephalopod found in the eastern Pacific Ocean, known for its ability to rapidly change color and hunt in coordinated groups. It can grow up to 1.5 meters long and is an opportunistic predator, feeding on fish and other squid using its sharp beak and powerful tentacles.

name: Leatherback Sea Turtle
general_info: The leatherback sea turtle is the largest of all sea turtles, distinguished by its unique leathery shell instead of a hard carapace. It is a highly migratory species, traveling thousands of kilometers across oceans to feed on jellyfish, which it consumes in large quantities.

name: Great Horned Owl
general_info: The great horned owl is a powerful and adaptable bird of prey found across the Americas, known for its distinctive ear tufts and deep hooting call. It is a skilled hunter with excellent night vision and a strong grip, capable of taking down prey much larger than itself.

name: Sparrow
general_info: Sparrows are small, social birds found worldwide, known for their adaptability to urban environments and distinctive chirping. They primarily feed on seeds and insects and often build nests in close proximity to humans.

name: Orca
general_info: Orcas, also known as killer whales, are highly intelligent and social marine mammals that live in complex family groups called pods. They are apex predators with a diverse diet, using sophisticated hunting techniques to catch prey ranging from fish to large marine mammals.

name: Right whale
general_info: Right whales are large, slow-moving baleen whales known for their massive heads covered in rough patches called callosities. They are filter feeders that primarily consume tiny zooplankton and are among the most endangered whale species due to past whaling and ongoing threats like ship strikes and entanglement in fishing gear.

name: Wild duck
general_info: Wild ducks or mallards are highly adaptable waterfowl found in lakes, rivers, and wetlands worldwide, known for their strong flying abilities and diverse plumage. They are omnivorous, feeding on plants, insects, and small aquatic creatures, and many species migrate seasonally over long distances.

name: Domestic pigeon
general_info: Domestic pigeons are descendants of wild rock doves, known for their strong homing instincts and ability to adapt to urban environments. They have been used throughout history for communication, companionship, and racing, and they thrive on a diet of grains and seeds.

name: European herring gull
general_info: The European herring gull is a large, widespread seabird found along coastal regions of Europe, known for its striking white and grey plumage and loud, harsh call. It is an opportunistic feeder, often scavenging for food in urban areas and on fishing boats, and can live in a variety of coastal and inland habitats.

name: Doe
general_info: A doe is a female deer, typically found in a variety of species including white-tailed, mule, and red deer. Known for their graceful movements, does primarily graze on vegetation and play a key role in the reproductive cycles of deer populations.

name: Red fox
general_info: The red fox is a highly adaptable mammal with a distinctive reddish-orange coat, found across a wide range of habitats from forests to urban areas. It is an omnivorous predator, hunting small animals, birds, and insects, but also feeding on fruits, vegetables, and human food scraps.
